caption:
IMO member states have agreed the next steps in shipping's decarbonization pathway, with new measures aimed at cutting greenhouse gas emissions from international shipping.

The measures build on the IMO's existing decarbonization strategy and will be developed further at upcoming committee sessions.

Source: IMO (imo.org)

title: IMO advances next steps on shipping decarbonization
